liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Big Boss Man** (3 reviews): Opener fits the flow of the three-night stand; the next night's version is said to be the bigger chug-fest; A classic mistake happened here; Bobby seemed to be in two places at once [20][21][23]
- **Looks Like Rain** (2 reviews): Listener was dazzled by this song, which hooked them on the Dead; Reviewer notes the song's placement in the second set as unusual [19][25]
- **Far From Me** (1 review): Reviewer thinks it earns a place in the rotation every ten shows or so [20]
- **Candyman** (1 review): Attendee was deeply moved by it and vowed to tell everyone the candyman was in town [27]
- **Hell in a Bucket** (1 review): Bootleg video shows Jerry dipping and dancing during it, to the point of seeming exhausted [22]

## Setlist highlights

- **Hey Jude Refrain**: rare: 10 archived performances [28]
- **NFA Reprise**: rare: 8 archived performances [28]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-04-09.mtx.tobin.91019.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 140 min [1]
- **gd1988-04-09.156454.prefm.lamarre.miller.t.flac1644**: pre-FM broadcast master; 23 songs; 140 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1988-04-09.nak300.carpenter.andrewf.90487.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 140 min [4]
- **gd1988-04-09.dts.tobin.91632.flac**: source not stated; 24 songs; 140 min [5]
- **gd1988-04-09.sbd.miller.91241.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 142 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [8]. Said about its sound: Miller remaster of the soundboard is described as spectacular [23]
- **gd88-04-09.pre-fm.braverman.15098.sbeok.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 21 songs; 140 min; rated 4/5 by 8 [11]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hears little low end: Phil is hard to find and the kick drum sounds sharp [26]

## Around the show

- Jerry was smiling throughout, with soulful, clean vocals and playing, especially in the second set [16]
- Attendee went with about 30 friends to an Irish bar near the venue afterward; says it was the last Centrum show the band played [17]
- On the drive back to Boston, an MIT radio station played digitally speed-altered frog recordings [17]
- Public-access fundraisers on the broadcast fumbled the wiring momentarily and only reacted once Jerry started singing [20]
- The broadcast includes Brent and others singing Happy Birthday to Billy, plus a Mickey joke [2]
- Setlist judged weaker than the first night's, though still a hot show [16]
- Calls night 1 the best of spring 88; says this second night is also strong [19]
- Considered as good as night 1; reviewer suggests skipping night 2 [22]
- Reviewer thought the opening was great but the show declined afterward, despite a strong song selection [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-04-09.mtx.tobin.91019.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 3 Source Mix (50%-SBD/50%-AUD) [1]. Also: Matrix mixing a soundboard with a cassette master (Nakamichi DR-1), transferred and mastered by Charlie Miller, with pitch correction; Another source, shnid 15098, was used only for patches; its lineage runs master reel, VHS, DAT, CD, SHN [1]
- **gd1988-04-09.156454.prefm.lamarre.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Doug Lamarre a few days after the show; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 13, 2022; source: Pre-FM (WCUW-FM) > Reel Master > VHS HiFi (Scott SVR330S) [2]
- **gd1988-04-09.nak300.carpenter.andrewf.90487.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ted Carpenter; transferred by Andrew F; source: Namamichi CM300's w/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's, with no Dolby. Mics on stand in OTS. [4]. Also: Nakamichi 300 tape source with patches from shnid 82671 covering tape flips in Space and the NFA crowd chant [4]
- **gd1988-04-09.dts.tobin.91632.flac**: transferred by Matrix by Kevin Tobin; source: DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix [5]. Also: DTS surround mix of the show, made by an archive.org user [5]
- **gd1988-04-09.sbd.miller.91241.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) D [8]
- **gd88-04-09.pre-fm.braverman.15098.sbeok.shnf**: source: pre-FM Master Reel> VHS (PCM)> DAT> CD> SHNvia Skip Jenkins, encoded by Peter Braverman [11]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [GRATEFUL DEAD 1988 CENTRUM WORCESTER MA ORIGINAL CONCERT POSTER PSYCHEDELIC ART | #4752102800](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-1988-centrum-worcester-4752102800) [29]
